subject: english
stem: A: Donate a book and help young readers. B: Volunteers, sort donated books by age. Which statement fits?
options: A requests donations; B assigns volunteer work.
A trains volunteers; B requests money.
Both are written only for children.

optionRationales.reason: A requests donations; B assigns volunteer work.：donate 面向捐贈者，Volunteers 指派分類。
A trains volunteers; B requests money.：兩端錯。
Both are written only for children.：A 面向捐書者，B 面向志工。
Both review a novel.：未評論書。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「文件的動詞、稱呼與行動要求揭示各自服務的讀者與目的」可推出 A requests donations; B assigns volunteer work.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 A requests donations; B assigns volunteer work. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
